hp_hpi: Angela Lucero is a 48 years old female with opioid use disorder (injects heroin and fentanyl), bipolar II and untreated hepatitis C who presents with 5 days of increasing pain, redness and swelling of the left calf after injecting into the back of her leg. She has had chills at night. She lives in an encampment by the LA River and has been homeless for about 3 years. In our ER, temp 38.6, HR 112, WBC 16.9, lactate 1.8. Bedside ultrasound showed a 3.4 cm fluid collection of the L posterior calf. Venous duplex showed occlusive thrombus of the left popliteal and posterior tibial veins. She was given IV vancomycin (developed flushing) and changed to linezolid, and started on heparin drip.
